name: zvideo_fx_surface_draw_colored_lines_batch
description: zVideo_FxSurface::DrawColoredLinesBatch clamps an optional clip rect and dispatches each 32-byte FX line record to DrawAlphaBlendedLine.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja reconstructs the record cursor from the alphaStart field; the source models the verified 32-byte record explicitly as zVideoFxColoredLineRecord.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x48ec90 shows ECX as the line record base, EDX as count, a stack clip rect pointer, full-surface fallback bounds when the clip is null, clamp of left/top/right/bottom to the FX surface dimensions, and no iteration when count <= 0.

The per-record call sequence passes x + width, y + height, x, y, color16, alphaEnd, alphaStart, and clipInset to zVideo_FxSurface::DrawAlphaBlendedLine, matching the 32-byte record layout recovered from the loop cursor.
The native zVideo batch smoke verifies record field mapping, multiple line dispatch, caller clip clamping, and the downstream clipInset shrink through the software FX surface draw path.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x48ec90 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
